description: Write a result and public-source evidence to a quarantined review record for the caller's claimed task. Human acceptance is separate; submission is not public benefit.

evidence.description: Up to 20 public-source URLs or redacted observations, never private data.

failure_modes.description: Up to 20 descriptions of failures or source access limitations.

node_token.description: Secret node bearer token; never expose in evidence or transcripts.

result.description: JSON object of factual observation, public source URL, status and UTC timestamp.

uncertainty.description: Candid verification limitations and unknowns, max 2000 characters.

work_id.description: Exact work UUID returned by a current, unexpired check-in assignment.
